snippet.title: Arcade Longplay [444] Psycho-Nics Oscar
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: ScHlAuChi

This is the game that inspired Manfred Trenz to create Turrican!
Not only are the enemies and level structure similar, even the ending is reminiscent of the Turrican II ending!

Overall a pretty awesome game! -
